tasks.subject: Task 1: `cave-capture` crate and the capture bundle format
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pure crate whose `encode`/`decode` round-trip a shot (header, mesh, keyframe photos) as one versioned binary file and refuse malformed input.

**Files:**
- Create: `crates/cave-capture/Cargo.toml`, `crates/cave-capture/src/lib.rs`, `crates/cave-capture/src/bundle.rs`
- Test: `crates/cave-capture/tests/bundle.rs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `decode(&encode(&shot)) == Ok(shot)` for a shot with 3 vertices, 1 triangle, 2 keyframes
- [ ] Wrong magic, newer format version, truncated bytes, index out of range, non-finite vertex each return a distinct `BundleError`
- [ ] `cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p cave-capture` succeeds

**Verify:** `cargo test -p cave-capture --test bundle` → `test result: ok. 7 passed`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/cave-capture/Cargo.toml", "crates/cave-capture/src/lib.rs", "crates/cave-capture/src/bundle.rs", "crates/cave-capture/tests/bundle.rs"], "verifyCommand": "`cargo test -p cave-capture --test bundle` \u2192 `test result: ok. 7 passed`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`decode(&encode(&shot)) == Ok(shot)` for a shot with 3 vertices, 1 triangle, 2 keyframes", "Wrong magic, newer format version, truncated bytes, index out of range, non-finite vertex each return a distinct `BundleError`", "`cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p cave-capture` succeeds"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Placement math (capture frame → survey frame, heading from a tap)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure functions that turn a shot's capture-frame points into survey coordinates, given the station position, instrument height and the heading tap.

**Files:**
- Modify: `crates/cave-capture/src/frame.rs`, `crates/cave-capture/src/lib.rs` (restore the `frame` re-export)
- Test: `crates/cave-capture/tests/frame.rs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `capture_to_survey([1,2,3]) == Vec3{x:1, y:-3, z:2}`
- [ ] `bearing_deg` is clockwise from north in 0..360 (north 0, east 90, south 180, west 270)
- [ ] A tap pointing straight down capture −Z at a station due east of the shot station gives a placement that maps capture (0,0,−5) to 5 m east of the station
- [ ] A tap within 2° of vertical returns `None` (no bearing from a vertical ray)

**Verify:** `cargo test -p cave-capture --test frame` → `test result: ok. 6 passed`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/cave-capture/src/frame.rs", "crates/cave-capture/src/lib.rs", "crates/cave-capture/tests/frame.rs"], "verifyCommand": "`cargo test -p cave-capture --test frame` \u2192 `test result: ok. 6 passed`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`capture_to_survey([1,2,3]) == Vec3{x:1, y:-3, z:2}`", "`bearing_deg` is clockwise from north in 0..360 (north 0, east 90, south 180, west 270)", "A tap pointing straight down capture \u2212Z at a station due east of the shot station gives a placement that maps capture (0,0,\u22125) to 5 m east of the station", "A tap within 2\u00b0 of vertical returns `None` (no bearing from a vertical ray)"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Rust core for Swift (`capture-ffi` + xcframework)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A static library with a small C interface (JSON and byte buffers in and out) that Swift links as `CaptureCore.xcframework`.

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/capture-ios/rust/Cargo.toml` (workspace + package), `apps/capture-ios/rust/src/lib.rs`, `apps/capture-ios/rust/include/capture_core.h`, `apps/capture-ios/rust/include/module.modulemap`, `apps/capture-ios/rust/build-xcframework.sh`, `apps/capture-ios/rust/.gitignore`
- Test: `apps/capture-ios/rust/src/lib.rs` (`#[cfg(test)]` module)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `cc_stations` on a snapshot text returns JSON `[{"id","label","x","y","z"}]`
- [ ] `cc_shot_encode` + `cc_shot_summary` round-trip a shot built from JSON + buffers; the summary carries vertex/triangle counts and the placed bounding box in survey coordinates
- [ ] Every returned buffer is released by `cc_free`; a null or bad input returns an `{"error": ...}` JSON, never a crash
- [ ] `build-xcframework.sh` produces `apps/capture-ios/CaptureCore.xcframework` with `ios-arm64` and `ios-arm64-simulator` slices

**Verify:** `cd apps/capture-ios/rust && cargo test && ./build-xcframework.sh && ls ../CaptureCore.xcframework` → tests pass, `Info.plist ios-arm64 ios-arm64-simulator` listed

tasks.subject: Task 7: One handheld LiDAR shot, saved as a bundle
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The capture screen runs ARKit scene reconstruction, takes the heading tap on the forward station, keeps keyframes, refuses to start in the dark, and on Stop writes `<shot>.cvcap` to the phone.

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/capture-ios/Sources/ShotRecorder.swift`, `apps/capture-ios/Sources/ShotFiles.swift`
- Modify (replace): `apps/capture-ios/Sources/CaptureView.swift`
- Test: `apps/capture-ios/Tests/ShotRecorderTests.swift`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `ShotRecorder.shouldKeep(lastYaw:yaw:lastTime:time:)` keeps a frame after ≥15° of turn or ≥2 s, never more than one per 0.25 s
- [ ] `ShotRecorder.mergeAnchors` puts two anchors' triangles into one mesh with world-space positions and correct index offsets
- [ ] Start is refused (message shown) when ARKit's ambient intensity is under 150 lumens or tracking is not normal
- [ ] Heading tap required before Start; tapping records the camera's forward ray
- [ ] Stop writes `Documents/shots/<caveId>/<shotId>.cvcap`; `Core.summary` of it reports `placed: true` and non-zero vertices

**Verify:** `xcodebuild test -scheme CaveCADCapture -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' | tail -3` → `** TEST SUCCEEDED **`; on the iPhone, one shot of a room at home saves and its summary shows vertices > 1000.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/capture-ios/Sources/ShotRecorder.swift", "apps/capture-ios/Sources/ShotFiles.swift", "apps/capture-ios/Sources/CaptureView.swift", "apps/capture-ios/Tests/ShotRecorderTests.swift"], "verifyCommand": "`xcodebuild test -scheme CaveCADCapture -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' | tail -3` \u2192 `** TEST SUCCEEDED **`; on the iPhone, one shot of a room at home saves and its summary shows vertices > 1000.", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`ShotRecorder.shouldKeep(lastYaw:yaw:lastTime:time:)` keeps a frame after \u226515\u00b0 of turn or \u22652 s, never more than one per 0.25 s", "`ShotRecorder.mergeAnchors` puts two anchors' triangles into one mesh with world-space positions and correct index offsets", "Start is refused (message shown) when ARKit's ambient intensity is under 150 lumens or tracking is not normal", "Heading tap required before Start; tapping records the camera's forward ray", "Stop writes `Documents/shots/<caveId>/<shotId>.cvcap`; `Core.summary` of it reports `placed: true` and non-zero vertices"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
